is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles coluzzii.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the presence of L1014F and ace-1R mutations in the study area (page 3), but it does not report new genotype data or frequencies for these markers from the mosquitoes collected in this specific study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide any genotype counts or frequencies for the mosquitoes collected in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in the Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating the efficacy of VECTRON T500.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in the Vallée du Kou, commune of Bama, Burkina Faso.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from May 2021 to May 2022.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new community trial.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is reported in the paper or its supplements.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the residual efficacy of VECTRON T500 (broflanilide) compared to Actellic 300CS in a community trial in Burkina Faso. While it discusses insecticide resistance and mentions the presence of kdr and ace-1R mutations in the region, it does not perform or report any new genotyping of these markers for the collected mosquitoes.
